title: Koke kara Hajimaru Isekai Life
titleNative: 苔から始まる異世界ライフ
synonyms: Starting Life from Moss in Another World
synopsis: Hikaru, who died at just 20 years old, was granted reincarnation in another world by a goddess's mercy. But due to a mistake, he wasn't reborn as a human; he became moss! “I'll die for real if I don't do something!” Terrified to begin his new life as the weakest possible creature with abysmal stats, Hikaru strategizes how to survive using his rebirth bonus: Additional Skill Acquisition. As he defeats nearby small animals with his chosen skills and newly learned magic to grind levels, he makes an incredible discovery: his moss form can evolve into other species. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

synopsis: The dragon slayer Leon was defeated and captured by the Silver Dragon Queen. With his life on the line, he tried to use forbidden magic to curse the dragon queen, but the curse had unexpected side effects, and the queen lost control as they had a one-night stand. synopsis: An empire falling to ruin: The Kio Empire. Living in that empire, is an overweight 5-year-old abandoned by his parents, Prince Ageha. Ageha has memories from a previous life of him living as a Japanese man in another world. He then encounters his younger half-brother, Regulus. Ageha had a vision that Regulus will kill him in the future over inheritance, so Ageha sets out to raise him after Regulus's mother passed. Once the sparkling and fluffy-haired Regulus cozied up to Ageha, He turned into a doting older brother before he even realized! Enjoy a fantasy story of young brothers managing their kingdom, sometimes involving the gods, as they reform it step by step to bring a better land to the next generation! (Source: MangaPlaza)

title: Irina: The Vampire Cosmonaut
synonyms: ノスフェラトゥ
synopsis: In an alternate version of the 1960s, two global superpowers have emerged after a savage war: the Zirnitra Union and the United Kingdom of Arnack. East and West are locked in a fierce race to send the first crewed flight into outer space, leading the Union to develop a secret agenda: the Nosferatu Project, which aims to use vampires as spaceflight test subjects. Similar to humans but feared and reviled, vampires are assumed to make the perfect "guinea pigs" for such a dangerous task. Lev Leps, a Union soldier and aspiring cosmonaut, is tasked with overseeing vampire Irina Luminesk aka N44, who has been chosen for the operation–and he can't quite detach his feelings from the vampire girl as planned. Faced with pressure and peril, will either of them manage to fly into the cosmos? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
